look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson twenty-three
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 5, lesson T23, Full Scalping Decision Lifecycle; an eight-step loop draws around a DEMO badge; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: Eight steps
scenes.desc: The capstone: eight step cards in order, from choosing a coin to the journal; educational simulation, demo only; scored on process, not profit.

scenes.name: Step 1 · Choose a coin
scenes.desc: Liquidity defined; made-up BTC/USDT (deep book, spread about 0.003%) against XYZ/USDT (thin book, 1% spread); BTC/USDT chosen on a 1,000 USDT demo account.

scenes.name: Step 2 · Context
scenes.desc: A fictional 5-minute chart: higher highs and higher lows, trend leans up; the last three 5-minute candles become fifteen 1-minute candles with a run up and a pull-back.

scenes.name: Step 3 · Range and levels
scenes.desc: On the 1-minute chart: range 59,850 to 60,650 = 800 USDT, about 1.3%; support zone 59,850-59,950 touched twice; resistance 60,550-60,650; price now 60,000.

scenes.name: Step 4 · Write down doubts
scenes.desc: Notes typed in: leaning (bounce from support), against (support tested twice), wrong if below 59,700, confidence medium; two possible paths fork from the price.

scenes.name: Step 5 · Costs and risk
scenes.desc: Entry 60,000, stop 59,700 (0.5%), target 60,600 (1%); example budget 6 USDT, fees about 1 USDT, 5 USDT for the move, notional 5 / 0.5% = 1,000 USDT at 1x; stop about -6, target about +9.

scenes.name: Step 6 · Decide
scenes.desc: DEMO BUY, DEMO SELL and NO_TRADE buttons; a written reason types in; DEMO BUY is chosen with stop and target set; a demo ticket appears.

scenes.name: Step 7 · Monitor and exit
scenes.desc: Three possible paths fan out; the replay forms eight 1-minute candles: up to 60,400, then down through support; the stop triggers and fills at 59,680; open PnL meter moves and freezes at -5.33.

scenes.name: Step 8 · Journal
scenes.desc: Journal card fills in: plan, exit, result -5.33 price, -1.00 fees, -6.33 net; process score ticks to 8 of 8; demo balance 993.67 USDT.

scenes.name: The NO_TRADE route
scenes.desc: Same chart and numbers; a second learner writes doubts and picks NO_TRADE: 0 USDT, no fees, process complete, a success decided before knowing the outcome.

scenes.name: Common mistakes
scenes.desc: Moving the stop (loss about 6 becomes about 11), doubling size to win back a loss (risk doubles), judging only by profit; each with its correction.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and calculate: stop 1% away, 5 USDT for the move; options 1,000 / 500 / 5,000 USDT; 5-second countdown; answer B, 500 USDT; why not A.

scenes.name: Honest limits
scenes.desc: Simulation is not the market; careful plans still lose; leverage and liquidation; fictional and educational, NO_TRADE always allowed.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and a check question: followed the plan and still lost, bad decision? Not necessarily.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: Phase 5 lessons complete; next, Checkpoint B (CPB), a video recap of T14 to T23.
